title: I Have a Pony by Steven Wright - Cassette - As Seen In Pics
descriptionText: "I Have a Pony" by Steven Wright is a comedy and spoken word album released on cassette by Warner Bros. in 1985. Produced by William E. McEuen, the album features a mix of humor and storytelling from the artist. The cassette format allows for easy listening of the comedic and entertaining tunes, making it a popular option for those who appreciate the unique blend of comedy and music offered by Steven Wright.
